overview: Enterprise Occupational Health, Safety & Environment (OHSE) command center for Ramkrishna Titagarh Rail Wheels Limited. Features domain-restricted login for @rktrwheels.com employees, role-based access control, and 12 fully functional modules for incident reporting, permit management, risk assessment, training tracking, environmental monitoring, and compliance.
features: Domain-restricted login for @rktrwheels.com employees with 6 role types
Enterprise dashboard with 8 animated KPI cards, safety score ring, incident trend charts, activity feed
Incident Reporting with multi-section forms, auto ticket numbers, and full approval workflow
Permit To Work with 6 permit types, countdown timers, QR codes, and workflow states
Risk Assessment with 5x5 risk matrix, hazard library, and control hierarchy pyramid
Inspections with audit calendar, checklists, findings tracker, and CAPA assignments
Training Matrix grid with certifications, expiry alerts, and competency tracking
Environment module with emission, water, energy, and waste tracking charts
CAPA Tracker with workflow states and action plan management
Multi-chart Analytics dashboard with date range filtering
Admin Panel with user management, role assignment, and department setup
Collapsible sidebar with all 13 OHSE module links
Industrial dark/light theme (deep navy + safety green) with glassmorphism cards
Backend-stored mock data with full delete capability on all records
Framer Motion animations — page transitions, KPI counters, card hovers
